name: @flow/android
description: Android client: packages/web in a Capacitor shell (docs/design/ANDROID.md). No `build` script on purpose — `pnpm -r build` must not need an Android SDK; the APK is built by `apk:debug` / the android.yml workflow.

scripts.apk:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug
scripts.apk:debug:dev: cross-env-shell FLOW_ANDROID_DEV=1 "cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug"
